thread.title: Apple, chipmaker stocks fall after TSMC delivers weaker-than-expected outlook - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple, chipmaker stocks fall after TSMC delivers weaker-than-expected outlook - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -1.90% and several chipmakers are down in Thursday morning trading after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. TSM, -5.24% delivered a June-quarter outlook that came up short of expectations. Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini wrote Thursday that he and his team were "lowering our estimates for TSM to account for a steeper than expected inventory digestion by premium Smart Phone customers, particularly Apple." Apple's stock is down 1.9%, while Intel's stock is off 2.3%. Other chipmakers have seen their shares hit as well, including Nvidia Corp. NVDA, -1.94% Qualcomm Inc. QCOM, -4.28% Broadcom Ltd. AVGO, -2.30% and Applied Materials Inc. AMAT, -2.89% The PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, -2.42% is off 2.8%, while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.45% is down 0.5%.
